content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(AIACC-001 Pre-flight LLM Provider Egress Plugin Registered) OR XQL(AIACC-001 Source Code Shape POST to OpenAI With Canary Marker) OR XQL(AIACC-001 DLP Source Code Structure Regex Match in LLM Prompt) OR XQL(AIACC-001 NGFW Generative AI App-ID Outbound HTTPS to OpenAI) OR XQL(AIACC-001 Repeated Source Paste Burst to OpenAI Single User)
